coordinate_observation.basis: In side_negative_y, screen-right is +X. The triangular buttstock is screen-right/raw +X and the twin rails terminate screen-left/raw -X.

cyan_twin_emitters_at_front.finding: Two vertically aligned cyan hexagonal emitter caps are centered on the actual raw -X rail front. Closed emitter caps are accepted by explicit user direction.

no_cyan_fake_muzzle_at_rear.finding: The raw +X buttstock terminates in one neutral gray closed pad with no cyan emitter face.

mesh_integrity.finding: No missing receiver/stock section, catastrophic fusion, or detached floating mesh is visible in the eight-view inspection.

hand_contact_possible.finding: The trigger grip and separate forward underside support handle are continuous, distinct and physically contactable.
